subject: Security evidence: VM operational handbook & remediation matrix
messages:
From: Marcus Lee <security@acmepay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: VM evidence request — scan cadence & CVE SLAs

Hi Mateo / Redwood team,

Acme Payments is kicking off a scoped SIG/CAIQ review and our auditor (TrustAssure) requested a focused vulnerability management evidence package covering scan cadence, sample scan exports, and your CVE remediation SLA/attestation. Specifically we need: 

- A short operational handbook describing your scan cadence and triage process (redacted ok)
- Recent scan exports (last 90 days) with high/critical findings called out (redacted exploitability ok)
- A CVE ownership matrix mapping component -> owner -> expected remediation window
- A signed attestation describing your SLA for critical/severe CVEs

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Auditor prefers a secure upload or a shared Drive link rather than email attachments. Our target for completing the evidence review is the week of 2027-09-27; initial intake by 2027-09-21 would be ideal.

If there are any expected exceptions (third-party vendor timelines, public-cloud patch windows) please call them out.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lee
Senior Security Engineer — Acme Payments
security@acmepay.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <security@acmepay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM evidence request — scan cadence & CVE SLAs

Marcus — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a redacted evidence packet and a signed SLA attestation. Plan and timeline below: 

What we will deliver (initial package):
- vm-operational-handbook-redacted.pdf (scan cadence, triage flow, patch windows)
- scan-index-2027Q3.csv (summary index referencing redacted exports stored on secure share)
- cve-ownership-matrix-202709.xlsx (owner, component, first-seen, remediation-status)
- vm-sla-attestation-draft.pdf (internal draft — we'll finalize and send a sign-ready copy)

Timeline: 
- Initial redacted packet (above) by 2027-09-19 EOD PT
- Secure Drive link with raw exports (restricted view) by 2027-09-20 EOD PT
- Final signed attestation by 2027-09-20 EOD PT (we can DocuSign if that works for you)

Notes / caveats: 
- We will redact detailed exploitability notes and internal IP addresses from exported logs; full unredacted logs can be shared over a trusted, temporary secure share for auditors under NDA.
- For third-party managed components we will include documented vendor patch windows and expected remediation exceptions in the ownership matrix.

Irene will follow up with SLA definitions and edge-case handling. If that timeline works, we'll proceed and send the secure link when ready.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments (will include in secure share): vm-operational-handbook-redacted.pdf; scan-index-2027Q3.csv; cve-ownership-matrix-202709.xlsx; vm-sla-attestation-draft.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <security@acmepay.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM evidence request — scan cadence & CVE SLAs

Marcus / team — looping in the SLA definitions so the attestation language is explicit. Quoting Mateo's plan above.

Short SLA definitions (summary — full language in attached cve-sla-definition.md):
- Critical: confirmed exploitability or active exploit; initial triage within 24 hours, mitigation plan published within 24 hours, remediation/patch deployed within 7 calendar days where possible. If a hotfix is not available due to vendor constraints, an interim mitigation with compensating controls is required and documented in the ownership matrix.
- Severe: high-impact vulnerabilities without active exploit; initial triage within 72 hours, remediation within 30 days.
- Medium / Low: prioritized based on risk and exposure; typical remediation windows 90 days / documented exceptions.

Exceptions and vendor-managed components: we annotate the ownership matrix for any component where remediation is dependent on an upstream vendor. For those, we provide expected vendor patch windows and any compensating controls we apply in the interim.

Evidence redaction policy for audits: we will redact PII, internal IPs, and exploit PoC details. Auditor-grade artifacts (full exports) can be made available in a time-limited secure share for TrustAssure under an NDA.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Mateo uploads the initial redacted packet to the secure Drive link and shares restricted access to TrustAssure.
2) We schedule a 30m walkthrough with your auditor to review the ownership matrix and SLA wording (Irene + Mateo).
3) We finalize the attestation and send a DocuSign link for Marcus to countersign/confirm acceptance.

I'll attach the SLA definition file to the secure share: cve-sla-definition.md

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lee <security@acmepay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: VM evidence request — scan cadence & CVE SLAs

Thanks Mateo / Irene — that approach works for us. Two quick asks before you upload: 

- Please share the secure Drive link with view-only access for TrustAssure (soc2@trustassure.com) and include a short README in the folder describing redactions and any artifact passwords.
- We'll need a DocuSign-ready attestation (vm-sla-attestation-final.pdf). If you can send a DocuSign envelope for TA-SIG-2027-09 (TrustAssure audit id: TA-SIG-2027-09) we can route internally and get signatures by 2027-09-24.

If possible, add the audit id to the attestation text so our tracker can close the loop. Once the Drive link is shared I'll confirm receipt and propose a 30m slot for the walkthrough.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Marcus
